description: If ponytail is missing or off, switch it back to full. Startup also says ponytail decides how much code to write and pstack decides the routine.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-guard.sh" startup; else echo "Ponytail level full is active for this whole command, including helper agents."; fi
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ponytail-guard.sh"; else echo "Ponytail level full is active for this whole command, including helper agents."; fi
